E1_1.note: endoscopy classes per repeat (FP-NP = non-progressor endoscopy flagged; TN-NP not flagged; TP-P progressor flagged; FN-P not flagged), covariate means weighted by the share of repeats in each class (averaged over repeats), paired patient bootstrap (rv8 pdraws, RandomState(0)); sample covariates taken from the endoscopy's top-H&E sample (highest repeat-mean outer L-IMG); standardised = difference / sqrt(mean of the two group variances); AUROC = weighted P(x in first group > x in second); patient level: non-progressor patients weighted by the share of repeats flagged
